Features the new 4-row lit top plane (3 tan rows + 1 bright lip) under a 1px back outline, and the shaded brown back wall makes the multi-tone books with lighter top page edges read cleanly.

Replaced the detached side arcs and 1px stick with a continuous foreshortened 14x6 elliptical brass orbit ring around a 4x4 shaded sun, horizontal cross-arm, and 2px shaded pillar across all 12 frames.
Preserves the 5-row lit grey upper control deck and bright front lip while replacing the flat lower front slab with three recessed, bevel-shaded steel service bays and a dark base kickplate.

Retains the 5-row lit gold top plane and bright lip while articulating the previously flat crimson front into a recessed 3-reel window, gold trim rail, framed belly panel, recessed coin chute, and stepped gold base.
The upper 4 rows are now a warm lit tan roof plane with a continuous 1px bright front lip above a shadowed 2-row cornice where the small gold cross sits over the center door.
Replaces the unlit dark-brown cornice with a 1px dark back edge, 4-row grained tan horizontal top plane, and 1px bright front lip above a 1px overhang shadow and the 2x3 glass relic doors.
Adds a 1px dark back outline, 4-row grained tan top plane, and 1px bright front lip above the shadowed cornice and 4x3 glass display panes, matching relic cabinet and the wardrobe reference.

Although rows 1-5 now form a 4-row lit tan top plane with a bright front lip (passing v34), the interior below row 6 is unchanged: each mattress still stops 2-3px short of the right post over a pure-black void with an unshaded 4x4 white block, reading as boxes on shelves at 1x.
